findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: FIRST REPEAT- The dispensers of the soda machine under the nozzles were observed to have an accumulation of soil residue on them. CORRECTED- The PIC cleaned the dispensers during the inspection. Ensure that staff are educated to clean both the nozzles and the dispensers of the soda machine. Ensure that food-contact surfaces are clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
The following TCS food items in the open-air cooler were observed to be above 41F: 

1. 26 packages of cheese and salami that probed to be between 48F and 55F. 
2. A chicken sandwich probed to be at 47F. 
3. A steak burrito probed to be at 52F. 
4. A chicken burrito probed to be at 49F. 
5. Two lunchables probed to be at 49F and 51F. 
6. Five egg and cheese protein packs probed to be between 46F and 55F. 
7. A bacon cheeseburger probed to be at 50F. 
8. A BBQ rib sandwich probed to be at 44F and 47F. 
9. A cheeseburger probed to be at 51F. 
10. Three jalapeño chicken sandwiches probed to be at 47F, 50F, and 51F. 
11. A country fried chicken sandwich probed to be at 52F. 
12. A pack of smoked ham and Swiss sliders probed to be at 46F. 
13. Two Italian style pinwheels probed to be at 48F and 54F. 
14. An Italian sandwich probed to be at 51F. 
15. A breakfast Stromboli probed to be at 50F. 
16. Two buffalo chicken wraps probed to be at 45F and 48F. 
17. Seven ham and cheese sandwiches that probed to be between 46F and 51F. 
18. Four turkey and cheese sandwiches that probed to be between 45F and 53F. 
19. Four packages of turkey and cheese sliders that probed to be between 47F and 53F. 

CORRECTED- The TCS food items were voluntarily discarded by the PIC. It was discussed to minimally stock items in the cooler on extremely hot days and to check the temperatures of the food items regularly. Open-air coolers need to be stocked less and to have non-TCS foods on the corners to ensure that they are able to be properly cold held. Ensure that TCS foods are being cold held at 41F and below.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to have an accumulation of dust on them and are in need of cleaning: 

1. FIRST REPEAT- The walk-in cooler fan covers. 
2. The walk-in cooler shelves. 

Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude the accumulation of soil residues.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: The scoop for the popcorn machine that is used by consumers to scoop popcorn is observed to not have a handle on it. This could lead to consumers touching the popcorn when scooping their own, as there is no distinction between the non-food and the food-contact surface of the scoop. A follow up is scheduled on 12/18/2025 to ensure that a scoop with a handle has been obtained.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The soda nozzles are observed to have an accumulation of soil residue in them. The PIC stated that these are supposed to be cleaned daily. A follow up is scheduled for 12/26/2025 to ensure that the soda nozzles have been cleaned. Ensure that food-contact surfaces are being frequently cleaned to prevent an accumulation of soil residue in them.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: There is not an ambient air thermometer in the walk-in cooler in the facility. This was discussed with the PIC. There should be an ambient thermometer in all cold or hot holding units, where the thermometer is in the warmest part of the cold unit or in the coolest part of the hot unit. Ensure that an ambient air thermometer is obtained for all cold and hot holding units in the facility that contain Time/Temperature for Control Safety (TCS) food items.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. There is a spill under the soda machines in the back area. Ensure that this spill is cleaned. 
2. The walk-in cooler fan covers are observed to have an accumulation of dust on them. Ensure that these are being regularly cleaned. 
3. FIRST REPEAT- There is ice-build up on the fan unit of the walk-in freezer. Ensure that this issue is repaired and the ice is removed to allow them to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are regularly cleaned to prevent the accumulation of soil residues.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There is missing coving behind the CO2 tanks in the back storage room and the wall is in disrepair where the coving is missing. This was shown and discussed with the PIC. Ensure that this coving is replaced. Physical facilities should be maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There were two mops that were observed to be sitting in the mop sink with the heads in the basin. CORRECTED- The PIC hung the mops to allow them to properly air dry. Ensure that after mops are used, they are placed in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.comment:
5-501.113: Observed the dumpster lids to not be closed during the investigation of the complaint. Operator stated that they are frequently left open by third parties and occasionally become overfilled. Ensure that the dumpster lids are routinely checked to ensure that they are closed and that the dumpsters do not become overfilled to prevent any debris from falling out. 

Receptacles and waste handling units for REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered: (A) Inside the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT if the receptacles and units: (1) Contain FOOD residue and are not in continuous use; or (2) After they are filled; and 174 (B) With tight-fitting lids or doors if kept outside the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: The facility did not have a bodily fluid clean-up kit or the Norovirus cleanup procedure. The facility was given a Norovirus cleanup procedure and they possess bleach to complete the procedure if needed. This violation was corrected on site. 

 A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: There was no paper towels at the handwashing sink in the back storage area. The operator replaced the paper towels during the inspection. Ensure that all handwashing sinks are stocked with a supply of paper towels. 

Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: There was no hand soap at the handwashing sink in the back storage area. The operator replaced the soap during the inspection. Ensure that all handwashing sinks are supplied with hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 

Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: The deli grab and go cooler up front was stocked past the point of refrigeration in a few of the areas. The items were probed and temped to be between 46F and 51F. The items, including but not limited to, packages of cheese curds and burritos, were voluntarily discarded by the operator after being probed. Ensure that the items in the cooler are not stocked past the point of refrigeration and that the temperature of the items within the cooler are frequently checked to ensure that they are 41F or below. 

(A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: In the walk-in cooler, there were cases of drinks being stored on the floor and in the walk-in freezer, there were boxes of food being stored on the floor. All food and drink should be stored at least six inches off of the floor to avoid contamination. During the inspection, these boxes and cases were moved off of the floor and on to the shelves. This violation was corrected on site. 

(A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The shelves in the walk-in cooler are observed to be soiled with debris. There is also ice build up underneath the fans in the walk-in freezer. The shelves need to be cleaned and then maintained cleaned. The ice needs to be scraped off to allow the area to be smooth and easily cleanable. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned as frequently as necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: There was a mop in a mop bucket of dirty water in the back storage room during the inspection. The operator moved the mop out of the water and into the squeegee portion of it. This violation was corrected on site. Ensure that all mops are always placed in a position to allow them to air dry. 

After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The following areas were observed to be in need of repair: 

1. There is bare wood holding up the handwashing sink. Ensure that this wood is either removed or sealed. 
2. The coving is coming away from the wall around the triple sink. Ensure that this is repaired and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 
3. The insulation next to the walk-in cooler door needs to be made smooth and easily cleanable. 
4. There is a missing ceiling tile above the walk-in cooler door. Ensure that this ceiling tile is replaced. 
5. The coving by the back door is coming away from the wall. Ensure that this is repaired and made to be smooth and easily cleanable. 

Ensure that all of these areas are repaired and are smooth and easily cleanable by the next routine inspection. 

 PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas were observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. There are soda spills in the back storage room under the soda syrups. Ensure that these spills and any future ones are cleaned. 
2. The floor of the walk-in freezer is observed to be soiled and in need of a cleaning. 
3. The floor by the back door is soiled and there are multiple dead bugs in this area. Ensure that this area is cleaned and maintained cleaned. 

Ensure that all of these areas are cleaned and then cleaned as often as necessary to maintain them clean. 

(A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
The tea dispenser did not have a lid covering the top of the dispenser. Ensure the lids are replaced after tea is brewed to protect tea from contamination. The lid was placed over the tea during the inspection to protect it from contamination. 

3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures
findings.comment:
The burrito and cheeseburger hot holding unit was not holding temperatures properly. The cheeseburgers and burritos were holding temperatures between 105F and 112F. The foods were discarded. After looking at the hot holding unit, the manager noticed that the unit’s had been turned off. After turning it on, the hot holding unit started functioning properly. This corrected the violation. 

3-501.16: (A) (1) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 135F or above. Roasts can be maintained at 130F or above.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 6-301.12: Observed no paper towels for use at hand sink located in back storage area. Towels were provided during inspection. Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-602.11: Observed several soda fountain nozzles to be soiled with debris. Wash, rinse and sanitize soda nozzles regularly to avoid soil accumulation. Nozzles were cleaned during inspection. (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: 4-602.12: Observed interior cavity of microwave located beneath roller grills to be soiled with food debris. Clean and sanitize interior cavity of microwave. (A) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking and baking EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours. This section does not apply to hot oil cooking and filtering EQUIPMENT if it is cleaned as specified in Subparagraph 4-602.11(D)(6). (B) The cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least every 24 hours by using the manufacturer's recommended cleaning procedure.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment: 4-903.11: Observed boxes of single use cups stored directly on ground in back storage room. Store single use articles at least 6 inches off ground. (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 4-602.13: Observed interior of drawers located beneath roller grills to be soiled with food debris. Wash and sanitize interior of drawers. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment: 3-501.18: (A) Observed creamer packages in creamer dispenser to have use by dates of 12/8 and 12/9.  Creamer was discarded. FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment: 3-501.17: (A) Observed no date marking present on packages of creamer in creamer dispenser.  Creamer was discarded. Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.12: (A) Observed a large amount of liquid on floor in back room behind soda fountains.  Water was cleaned up during inspection. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
